lines: Nnn... Roar!{be01}\nI want to dig that tunnel!
Nnn... Roar!{be01}\nThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!

我们的新精灵球很快
会在卡那兹市的友好
商店出售。{be01}
到时一定要试试！谢
谢，再见！
你的包包满了，装不\n下这重复球。
I dropped my glasses...\nCan you help me find them?
啊，那副眼镜！可以\n给我看看吗？
Hmm...\nI can’t find my glasses anywhere...{be00}\nMaybe they’re not around here...
Hmm...\nThese are Blackglasses.{be00}\nThey’re not what I’m looking for...

卡绿隧道“连接卡那
兹市和绿茵镇的隧道{be01}
